body:
Two immutable scientific reviews contain inaccurate local locator shorthand:

- `reviews/structured/20261014T164140Z-anilite-round76-independent/review.yaml` says `actual raw/goble1981.pdf` and `actual raw/whiteside1986-doclib.pdf`.
- `reviews/structured/20261014T164145Z-digenite-round76-independent/review.yaml` says `actual raw/whiteside1986-doclib.pdf`.

The inspected originals actually reside directly under `/private/tmp/cmm-round76-sulfides-research/`, with no `raw/` subdirectory in that acquisition root. The reviewer confirmed the phrase was shorthand for a variable, not a real relative path. Hidden/ignored-inclusive enumeration of the acquisition and reviewer roots verified the paths. The primary URLs and existing checksum bindings identify the correct nonempty originals; record science, reviewed target bytes and verdicts are unaffected.

Severity: minor review-provenance locator error. Preserve both native YAML/Markdown bundles unchanged. Add a timestamped metadata correction binding each exact review hash, affected evidence IDs/old locator, complete correct acquired-file path, bytes and SHA256. Explicitly retain the scientific verdict and scope, and verify the addendum in the final publication audit. No invented curation/history event or re-review of unchanged science is needed.
title: Correct raw-file locator shorthand in round76 sulfide review metadata
